content: Where a new building which is not a residential building or a mixed-use building has more than 10 parking spaces (a) one of those parking spaces must have access to one electric vehicle charge point; and (b) cable routes for electric vehicle charge points must be installed in a minimum of one fifth of the total number of remaining parking spaces.
question: A new building that is not a residential building or a mixed-use building must meet electric vehicle charge point requirements if it has more than how many parking spaces?
